title: GPSSB Gujarat 2,640 Posts - Pharmacist, MPHW & More, Last Date Tomorrow May 20
author: Ash K.
summary: Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board (GPSSB) recruitment for 2,640 posts including Pharmacist, MPHW, and other health staff. Last date to apply is May 20, 2026. Diploma and degree holders eligible. Apply at gpssb.gujarat.gov.in.
body: The Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board (GPSSB) has released recruitment notification for 2,640 posts across multiple healthcare positions. Last date to apply is tomorrow - May 20, 2026.

DetailInformation
Total Posts2,640
OrganizationGPSSB (Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board)
Posts IncludePharmacist, MPHW (Male), FHW, Lab Technician
Last DateMay 20, 2026 (TOMORROW)
EligibilityDiploma/Degree in relevant field
Age Limit18-35 years (relaxation as per Gujarat rules)
SelectionWritten Exam (MCQ)
Apply Atgpssb.gujarat.gov.in / ojas.gujarat.gov.in

Posts breakdown: Pharmacist - requires Diploma/Degree in Pharmacy + registered with Gujarat Pharmacy Council. MPHW (Male) - requires MPHW training certificate. Female Health Worker - requires ANM/FHW training. Lab Technician - requires DMLT/BMLT from recognized institution.

Selection process: Written examination with multiple-choice questions covering subject knowledge and general knowledge. No interview for most posts. Final merit list based on written exam marks and document verification.
How to apply: Visit gpssb.gujarat.gov.in or ojas.gujarat.gov.in → Select GPSSB Recruitment 2026 → Register → Fill form → Upload documents → Pay fee → Submit before May 20, 2026.
Important: Gujarat domicile is required. Candidates must be proficient in Gujarati language. All documents must be submitted during document verification in original.
For government healthcare job preparation, check our competitive exam guides. To check eligibility for related government schemes, use our Eligibility Checker.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for GPSSB 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is May 20, 2026 at gpssb.gujarat.gov.in or ojas.gujarat.gov.in.

faqs.question: What posts are available in GPSSB 2026?
faqs.answer: Pharmacist, Multi Purpose Health Worker (MPHW), Female Health Worker (FHW), and Lab Technician across 2,640 vacancies.

faqs.question: What qualification is needed for GPSSB Pharmacist?
faqs.answer: Diploma or Degree in Pharmacy from a recognized institution plus registration with Gujarat Pharmacy Council.

faqs.question: Is Gujarat domicile required for GPSSB?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gujarat domicile is required for all GPSSB posts. Candidates must also be proficient in Gujarati language.

callout.heading: Deadline TOMORROW
callout.content: The last date to apply for GPSSB 2,640 healthcare posts is May 20, 2026. If you have a Pharmacy diploma/degree, MPHW certificate, or DMLT qualification and are a Gujarat resident, apply NOW at gpssb.gujarat.gov.in.
